question: Why does this difference-nondifference state stand bloomed in sadākhya?
inference: The difference-nondifference state stands bloomed in sadākhya because that is knowledge-power-nature.
uncertainties: saiṣā may refer to a prior state.
plain_english: This difference-nondifference state stands bloomed; therefore it is in sadākhya, the nature of knowledge-power.
